title: The `mutants` profile kills a root test at 15 s

data.head: ## The `mutants` profile kills a root test at 15 s

body:
**What breaks:** under the nextest `mutants` profile a root test is killed at 15 s (5 s × 3), 5 s above `CONFIRM_WINDOW_FALLBACK`; a harness test (`package(viola-e2e)`) at 30 s. A test that waits out a designed floor (verify's waits of the gate's 8.5 s maximum, about 43 s; the product's 10 s confirmation window or a send under a held paste hint, 8.7–9.9 s, within a few seconds of the kill under host load) passes under profile `ci` and can be killed there, and a mutation run then ends before any mutant is graded. The first matching override wins, so a class override listed after a broader filter that also matches the test never applies.
**How to avoid:** a test that waits out a designed floor carries `send_window_`, `send_under_the_paste_hint_` or `verify_window_` in its name (30 s, 30 s and 60 s under `mutants`), and the `verify_window_` override stands ahead of `package(viola-e2e)`; `tests/contract_lints.rs` pins that order. Size any other new root case against the 15 s kill, not CI's 20 s.
**Fix if broken:** measure the floor first; rename the test into its class. A kill line moves only for a floor that is by design, with a planted-hang control, both readings recorded.
**References:** test-plan §3 Bootstrap phases `test-runner-install`, §10 Mutation gate; `.config/nextest.toml`; `.claude/rules/testing.md` 2026-09-24 (extended 2026-10-06), 2026-09-28 (extended 2026-10-05); chunk 2026-10-09-epoch-3-cleanup `evidence/e2e-floor.md`, `evidence/planted-hang.md`.

- 2026-09-24: A test wait that a mutant can reach must detect the watched process's exit (`try_wait`) and be bounded below cargo-mutants' 20 s auto-timeout floor, and so must the nextest mutants kill. Otherwise a mutant that makes the process exit silently spins to the bound and is graded Timeout instead of caught, depending on which tests the runner happens to schedule first. Extended 2026-09-27: a test's own assertion deadline must also sit below the nextest profile's kill line, or the kill preempts the test and its failure dump is lost. Extended 2026-09-27: a deadline EQUAL to the kill line is a race the test can lose — keep it strictly below, and have a spawned child stream its report to a known file outside the test's tempdir, so a runner kill still leaves the evidence. Extended 2026-10-06: a root test with no `send_window_` / `verify_window_` prefix runs under the `mutants` profile's 15 s kill, tighter than its 20 s CI kill, so size a new stamped-home case (the stamp alone is about 4 s) against the smaller one. [corrected 2026-11-15: the `mutants` default kill is 15 s (5 s × 3), the shared `WITHIN` 12 s, since chunk 2026-11-15-mutation-and-coverage-baselines-green]

- 2026-10-04: A test that binds a Unix socket binds it under a short test-owned root made in `/tmp`, never under `TMPDIR`: under a long mutation-run `TMPDIR` the path passes `sun_path`'s 107 bytes and cargo-mutants' unmutated baseline fails before any mutant runs. [corrected 2026-11-15: every `viola-test-chan-` socket now binds under the short `/tmp` root, so `TMPDIR`'s length no longer reaches a test socket; the old rule kept `TMPDIR` near 60 bytes instead]

title: 2026-11-15 — A «no product source changed» probe counts non-test hunks, not files

data.head: ## 2026-11-15 — A «no product source changed» probe counts non-test hunks, not files

body:
A plan's gate that proves a test-only chunk by listing changed files under `src/` and `crates/*/src/` reads a
`#[cfg(test)]` edit inside a product file as a product change, so a test-only fix that must touch an inline test
module reads red on the probe's wording, not on the work. Write such a probe over the diff's hunks: a hunk counts
only when it falls outside every `#[cfg(test)]` module of its file, and its control plants one non-test line to
show it fires (both directions read before it is trusted).

A test-only chunk: no product line changed outside test modules, no CLI output, refusal, exit code, colour or terminal byte moved.
The nextest mutants profile's default kill rose from 10 s to 15 s, and the shared root wait bound every test waits under (WITHIN) rose from 7 s to 12 s, still below the kill; per-case overrides unchanged.
Every test channel socket (viola-test-chan-pid-label) now binds under a short /tmp root ({temp root}/vs-XXXXXX), never under TMPDIR, so a long scratch TMPDIR no longer overflows sun_path; the swept sites span the channel crate's test modules, the e2e harness and the root tests.
Tests now give viola verify --record a home from a record-home helper whose path never holds a component named home, with a test proving it.
The Hyprland recorder tool (viola-hypr-tap) gained an integration test binary killing its ten mutation survivors, including its exit-2 refusal of each malformed argument form.
Measured: the whole workspace passes under the mutants profile (3286 tests), a planted hang times out at 15 s under it, and CI read green 7/7.
